    Anchialo Dual Magnesium Gel | Fast-Absorbing Muscle Relief

     

    Anchialo Dual Magnesium Gel is a fast-absorbing formula that delivers magnesium chloride and sulfate through the skin. It helps relieve muscle tension, soothe tired areas, and hydrate dry skin. Lightly fragranced for a fresh, enjoyable experience.

     

    Natural Topical Gel with Magnesium Chloride and Magnesium Sulfate derived from Black Sea lye 300g

     

    Effective for:

    • Muscle cramps, spasms, and fatigue

    • Joint pain, arthritis, and osteoarthritis

    • Sprains, dislocations, fractures, and disc hernias

    • Nerve discomfort and inflammation

    • Everyone experiences discomfort, whether from long hours at a desk, intense workouts, or other types of stress. We created ANCHIALO Dual Magnesium Gel as a convenient and effective solution.

      Whether you’re dealing with muscle discomfort, joint stiffness, or minor inflammation, this gel is designed to help. It's also beneficial for various skin concerns and can aid in maintaining magnesium levels in the body.

      With its soothing properties and mineral-rich formula, including magnesium from Black Sea lye, ANCHIALO offers both immediate comfort and supports overall wellness. Ideal for use at home or in professional settings like rehabilitation centers and wellness spas.

    • Black Sea lye is a mineral-rich liquid that forms naturally during the evaporation of seawater in salt lakes along the Bulgarian Black Sea coast. As the water evaporates, salt settles at the bottom, and a dense, dark, non-crystallised liquid called lye forms on top. This lye contains high levels of natural minerals like magnesium sulfate, magnesium chloride, and sodium chloride. Thanks to its rich mineral content and natural alkalinity, Black Sea lye has traditionally been used to support skin health, ease muscle and joint discomfort, and help the body recover after physical activity.

    • AQUA, MAGNESIUM SULFATE, MAGNESIUM CHLORIDE, SODIUM CHLORIDE, GLYCERIN, HYDROXYETHYLCELLULOSE, PARFUM, VITIS VINIFERA SEED EXTRACT

    • USAGE

      Massage the gel into clean, dry skin on the desired area. Leave on for 30 minutes to several hours, or overnight for deeper relaxation. If irritation occurs, rinse with cool water. Avoid sensitive areas and mucus membranes.

      PURPOSE

      This is fast-absorbing gel designed to delivers the natural benefits of magnesium chloride and magnesium sulfate through the skin, leaving the body feeling relaxed and revitalised after physical activity. Relieves muscle tension and soothes tired areas, hydrates and comforts dry skin. Lightly fragranced with a pleasant Grape aroma for a fresh and enjoyable experience.

    • CAUTION: 

      For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. This product should not replace medical treatment.

      STORAGE: 

      Store at 5°C – 25°C. Avoid direct sunlight.
